question: Which one of the following occurs during anaphase of mitosis in a healthy human liver cell?

choices.A: Chromatin condenses so that the chromosomes are visible under the microscope.
choices.B: Centrioles migrate to opposite poles of the cell and help to assemble the spindle fibres.
choices.C: DNA replicates so that each chromosome is made up of two sister chromatids.
choices.D: Sister chromatids are pulled by the spindle fibres towards opposite poles of the cell.
choices.E: Chromosomes move towards the equator of the cell and attach to the spindle fibres.

question:
An animal has a coat that has some patches of white hair and some patches of black hair. Cells that make up a hair follicle form a single hair, which is either white or black.

Assume that there are no mutations following formation of the zygote.

A student wrote the following statements:

1 The cells in all the hair follicles contain the same genes.
2 The alleles in a hair follicle forming a white hair are different from the alleles in the hair follicle forming a black hair.
3 Each white hair follicle cell contains two recessive alleles.

Which statement(s) is/are correct?
